name: How long does it take to paint interior trim throughout a house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint interior trim throughout a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting usually takes one to three days, depending on the number of rooms, drying conditions, and required finish carpentry repairs. A standard single room can often be prepped, caulked, and finished in a single day. Larger projects involving an entire home, high crown moldings, or extensive drywall patching take several days because caulk, primer, and topcoats must dry thoroughly between steps. In the greater Denver area, lower indoor humidity can speed up paint drying, but finish coats still require sufficient curing time before furniture or flooring transitions are placed against baseboards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting trim throughout a house typically takes one to three days, depending on home size, drying times, and whether caulking or woodwork repairs are needed.
